value.rationale: The 2021 source expressly asks how holding affects record ages. Simultaneous finite-horizon rankwise control gives a robust transport estimate and establishes universality of the full ranked age composition, not just the longest age or record-count moments. It applies to any active sample path and all fixed positive holding regimes and has utility independent of any unproved sharp rate.
